about: Two modules are both called utils (illustrative paths pkg_a/utils.py and pkg_b/utils.py). Their canonical ids are their repo-relative paths, so step 1 keeps them apart. A docs mention of plain 'utils' matches both canonical names and comes back ambiguous with both candidates; a mention of 'pkg_b.utils' matches one alias and is placed. The last two rows are the same shape in Auto Ontology's own repo at cdaf61e: two modules called service, with their real module docstrings.
